annotations.target_phrase: calm, perfectly focused, utterly crazy face of Armitage
annotations.annotation_text: The psychological collapse of Armitage as his synthetic persona disintegrates under pressure, revealing the catatonic trauma of Colonel Willis Corto before Wintermute executes him.
sources: Gibson, William. Neuromancer. Ace Books, 1984, p. 203.

annotations.annotation_text: Case describing Wintermute's communication strategy: projecting simulated human avatars (Lonny Zone, the Finn) because an AI cannot communicate directly with the human sensorium without psychic rupture.
sources: Gibson, William. Neuromancer. Ace Books, 1984, p. 203.
